notes.audio: Assets/audio/manifest.json is the canonical runtime/event contract. Existing weapon MP3s remain at the audio root until their runtime paths migrate into category folders.
notes.textures: Legacy deployment filenames reconstructed from the current and pinned loaders. Existing hosted texture files remain authoritative until their exact binaries are imported into Git.
notes.terrain: Baked terrain pack expected by terrain-baked.js. Existing hosted terrain files remain authoritative until their exact binaries are imported into Git.
